messages:
ivy: Heads up - ap-east1 showing a cluster of Pending pods requesting 0.25 vGPU. Lots of tiny unusable leftovers on nodes.

omar: Any recent config flips on vgpu allocator?

ivy: We moved to strict allocation two days ago. Might be interacting with node taints `vgpu-reserve: true`.

janet: scheduler metric reserve_failures spiked at 02:12UTC, look at logs.

ops-bot: Alert: ap-east1 vGPU fragmentation 72% for 20m. Impacted namespaces: ci, experiments.

ivy: excerpt from scheduler: I0507 02:11:59 allocator.go:120 reserve pod=infer-lite-a amount=0.25 txn=tx-998 I0507 02:12:00 webhook.go:45 prebind timeout txn=tx-998 err=timeout(300ms) I0507 02:12:00 allocator.go:160 orphan-reserve detected node=node-ae-12 orphan=0.25

omar: Looks like reserves not rolled back on webhook timeout. We should add a short TTL for reserves as a safety net.

janet: short-term: deploy reservation-sweeper in ap-east1 that releases orphaned fractions older than 45s. low blast radius.

sched-bot: Proposed canary patch: set reserveTTL=60s, prebindTimeout=500ms, reclaimInterval=30s.

ivy: I'll deploy sweeper now and monitor fragmentation + scale events.

omar: For medium-term, add idempotent rollback in prebind path and metric for reserveTTL expirations. Also schedule off-peak compaction window 03:00-04:00 local.

janet: action list: 1) ivy deploy sweeper (ETA 10m). 2) omar open scheduler PR for reserveTTL + telemetry. 3) ops monitor autoscaler churn.

ivy: deploying canary, will report in 15m :thumbsup:
